mapper.select: SELECT crm12_work_detail_id AS work_detail_id , crm12_contact_id AS contact_id , crm09_contact_nm AS contact_name , crm12_work_date AS work_date , crm12_reg_date AS reg_date , crm12_work_nm AS work_name , crm12_work_content AS work_content , (COALESCE(crm12_private_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS private_yn , crm12_person_id AS person_id , crm12_company_id AS company_id , (SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN crm15_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(crm15_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(crm15_org_id, f_today()) END FROM crm15_share WHERE crm15_work_detail_id = crm12_work_detail_id ORDER BY crm15_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1) ||(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '|| COUNT(*)-1 END) FROM crm15_share WHERE crm15_work_detail_id = crm12_work_detail_id) AS share_info FROM crm12_work_detail INNER JOIN crm09_contact ON crm09_contact_id = crm12_contact_id WHERE crm12_work_detail_id = #{workDetailId} AND crm12_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT crm13_relate_fund_id AS relate_fund_id , crm13_work_detail_id AS work_detail_id , crm13_fund_id AS fund_id , fnd01_fund_cd AS fund_code , f_get_fund_nm(fnd01_company_id, fnd01_fund_cd, f_sysdate()::date) AS fund_name FROM crm13_relate_fund INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code ON fnd01_fund_code_id = crm13_fund_id WHERE crm13_work_detail_id = #{workDetailId} ORDER BY fnd01_fund_cd DESC
